title: identities.json passkeys
description: The passkeys of the person. No credential ID, public key or sign count: those are key material and security state.

name.description: Name the person gave the passkey.

transports.description: Transports the authenticator reported, for example internal or usb; absent when none.

last_used_at.description: Last use of the passkey; absent when never used.

revoked_at.description: When the passkey was revoked; absent while it is valid.
